title: Family and Friends
label: ch:te-family-and-friends
canDo: I can name my family as a group in Telugu and name a friend, and say which of the two words is a Sanskrit loan and which is Telugu's own native word.

payoff.summary: Say ఇది నా కుటుంబం and ఇతను నా స్నేహితుడు, trace కుటుంబం and స్నేహితుడు back to Sanskrit, and set స్నేహితుడు beside the native, DEDR-attested నేస్తం.
